title: anim.wave.keysets/1
description: data/anim/waves/<wave>.keysets.json: the key sets of a parked strike wave (generated by render/anim/tools/wave_gen.mjs; baked only with --waves, no live match plays them). The same key set shape as data/anim/keysets.json, without picks; names may carry a variant (`w1.uppercut~b`). `_combat` is the Combat strike id it realises, `_wave` its wave, `_variant` and `_alt` a second take and what differs. Render only. Version field: schema. Policy: closed except keys starting with an underscore. Cross-references (every key pose is in the wave's poses file; each role once; target is a sockets.json region and limb and limb2 are sockets.json limbs) are checked by tools/lib/xref-fight.js (wave-*, anim-target, anim-limb).

target.description: Where the strike lands on the opponent (head, chest, gut ...).

limb.description: The limb that strikes: a part of sockets.json limbs, with its side (hand_r, foot_l, elbow_r, knee_l, shoulder_r) or head (no side).

step_max.description: How far (model units) the whole body may step to reach the target, overriding the limb's step_max in sockets.json.

tell_at.description: A super-heavy piece's tell: how far into the wind-up (0 to 1) the chamber is reached; it is then held in plain sight to the blow. 1 (the default) is the old linear ramp.

squash_w.description: How much of the press style's squash this piece takes (0 to 1, default 1): 0 draws its tell in its chamber alone.

drive.description: A super-heavy piece's drive: what the whole body does behind the limb (Combat's strike.heavy.drive, by id: step_through, turn, unwind, heave, fall, full_turn).

limb2.description: A second striking limb, for a two-limbed blow (a double palm, a clap).

tip.description: The striking surface as posed (docs/animation/moveset-parts.md): hand fist, blade, palm, heel (the back or bottom of the fist), plate (the forearm leads); foot ball, heel, instep, edge, sole; elbow point; knee cap; shoulder plate; head brow.

path.description: The angle the limb travels: line, arc_in (toward the centre line), arc_out (away from it), rise, drop, spin (one turn).
